name: SafeHub
summary:
SAFE HUB is an immersive, multi-user training platform for Meta Quest headsets that enables companies to train, simulate, and evaluate their workforce in interactive virtual environments in a scalable and collaborative way.

Designed for organizations that need to train large numbers of workers, SAFE HUB combines virtual reality, multi-user interaction, instructor tools, and performance metrics, transforming practical training into a measurable and replicable experience.
